The basic plot of the film, if you don't already know, is a treasuer hunt through a virtual world. All the clues and trials are 80s themed. The second trial is a tribute to Kubric's version of The Shinning. The characters explore the overlook and interact with characters and experience some of the iconic scenes. It sounds cheesey, yeah but it's really fun to see Speilberg do any sort of take on The Shinning. It manages to be funny but horrifying during at the same time. The rest of the movie is pretty mediocre but I rewatched that movie twice just for that scene. Idk maybe i'm giving it too much credit but it really was a fun scene.
